title: CORAL: Adaptive Retrieval Loop for Culturally-Aligned Multilingual RAG

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating end-to-end multiple-choice question answering accuracy on culturally grounded benchmarks (BLEnD and CLIcK) that test everyday knowledge and conventions specific to diverse countries and regions.

Comparing retrieval and question answering accuracy across low-, mid-, and high-resource language communities to assess performance disparities and mitigate the dominance of globally aggregated or high-resource corpora.
